Class TestDataFactory.TestSuite

public virtual class TestDataFactory.TestSuite

Known derived/implementing types:
TestDataFactory.TestBillSuite

Base class for test suites that create multiple related records. Provides common functionality for managing field value overrides and controlling which optional records should be created.

public TestDataFactory.TestSuite setFieldValue(
  String objectName,
  String fieldName,
  Object fieldValue
)

Configures a single field value override for a specific object type. If the object already has field overrides configured, this adds or updates the specified field. If no overrides exist for the object, a new map is created.

Parameters:
    objectName – The API name of the object
    fieldName – The API name of the field to set
    fieldValue – The value to assign to the field

Returns:
    TestSuite: This instance for method chaining
